units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 5) information on the decision concerning each application of each procurement commission member participating in examination of the applications and price offers submitted by participants;
units.label: Point 5 Part 6 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 6) information that the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 77(1) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 6 Part 6 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 7. A participant may ask the contracting authority for clarification of the results of examination of its application in the procedure provided for in Article 73(13) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 8. A contract following a closed auction shall be concluded in the procedure established by Article 73(14) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 9. If a closed auction is declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 77(1) of this Federal Law, it shall be conducted subject to the specific rules established by Article 77(3) and (4) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.label: Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 1. In a closed electronic tender, the invitation shall be sent and procurement documentation provided in the following procedure:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 1) the contracting authority shall use the unified information system to prepare an invitation, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf, and post it in that system, attaching the procurement documentation. The invitation must contain the information specified in Article 42(1)(1)–(10), (12), (13), (15)–(19) and (21) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 2) no later than one working day following their posting, the invitation and procurement documentation specified in point 1 of this paragraph shall be sent to the specialized electronic platform operator through information exchange between that platform and the unified information system, taking account of the requirements established under Article 24.1(2) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 3) no later than one working day following receipt of the invitation and procurement documentation specified in point 1 of this paragraph, the specialized electronic platform operator shall send invitations to participants accredited on that platform whose information and documents specified in the invitation and provided for in Article 42(1)(12) of this Federal Law are included in the register of participants accredited on the specialized electronic platform;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 4) no later than three working days following dispatch of the invitation under point 3 of this paragraph, a participant that received it may send the operator a request for procurement documentation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 5) within one hour following the day on which the period specified in point 4 of this paragraph expires, the specialized electronic platform operator shall send the contracting authority the requests for procurement documentation received from participants and the following information and documents concerning them:
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: а) those provided for in Article 43(6)(2) of this Federal Law, through information exchange between the specialized electronic platform and the unified information system, taking account of the requirements established under Article 24.1(2) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 5 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: б) those specified in the invitation under Article 73(2)(1) of this Federal Law, provided for in Article 42(1)(12) of this Federal Law and included in the register of participants accredited on the specialized electronic platform in accordance with Article 43(6)(4) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 5 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 6) within two working days following the contracting authority’s receipt of the information and documents specified in point 5 of this paragraph:
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: а) the procurement commission shall examine whether that information and those documents meet the requirements stated in the invitation and provided for in Article 42(1)(12) of this Federal Law, and decide to provide the participant with procurement documentation or refuse to do so on the grounds specified in paragraph 2 of this Article;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 6 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: б) the contracting authority shall use the specialized electronic platform to prepare a record of examination of requests for procurement documentation and, after the procurement commission members sign it, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf and send it to the specialized electronic platform operator;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 6 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 7) within one hour of receiving the record specified in point 6(б) of this paragraph, the specialized electronic platform operator shall:
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: а) notify every participant that requested procurement documentation of the commission’s decision following examination of the information and documents specified in point 5 of this paragraph. If the commission refused to provide documentation, the notice must state the reasons for that decision;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: б) send the procurement documentation specified in point 1 of this paragraph to the participant whom the commission decided to provide with it;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: в) send the record of examination of requests for procurement documentation to the federal executive body specified in Article 72(2) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: г) post the record of examination of requests for procurement documentation in the unified information system without publishing it on the official website.
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 2. The procurement commission shall refuse to provide a participant with procurement documentation if:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 1) the information and documents specified in paragraph 1(5) of this Article are not provided or do not meet the requirements in the invitation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 2) the participant does not meet the requirements stated in the invitation and provided for in Article 42(1)(12) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 3) inaccurate information is found in the information and documents specified in paragraph 1(5) of this Article.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 3. The record of examination of requests for procurement documentation must contain:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 1) the date of examination of requests for procurement documentation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 2) information on the participants whose requests for procurement documentation were examined;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 3) information on the decision to provide or refuse to provide procurement documentation to a participant, with reasons for the decision;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 4) information on the decision of each procurement commission member participating in examination of the requests concerning each request for procurement documentation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 5) information that the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 77(1) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 4. A participant that has received an invitation and been provided with procurement documentation may use the specialized electronic platform to send no more than three requests for clarification of that documentation. Within one hour of receiving a request, the specialized platform operator shall forward it to the contracting authority. Within two working days of receiving a request, the contracting authority shall send a clarification to the specialized platform operator, provided that the request was received at least three days before the application deadline. Clarifications must not change the substance of the documentation. Within one hour of receiving a clarification, the operator shall send it to all participants provided with documentation under this Article, stating the subject of the request but not identifying the participant that submitted it.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 5. On its own initiative or in response to a request under paragraph 4 of this Article, the contracting authority may amend the invitation or procurement documentation, posting the amendments in the unified information system in the procedure provided for in paragraph 1(1) of this Article no later than one working day before the application deadline. It may not change the name of the procurement subject matter or increase application security. No later than one working day following the amendments, but no later than the day before the application deadline, the amendments shall be sent to the specialized electronic platform operator in the procedure provided for in paragraph 1(2) of this Article. Within one hour of receiving them, the operator shall send them to all participants that received procurement documentation. The application period must be extended so that the period from the day following dispatch of the amendments to the application deadline is no shorter than the application period established by paragraph 6 of this Article.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 6. Only a participant that has been provided with procurement documentation in the procedure under this Article may submit an application. It may do so at any time from receipt of the documentation until the date and time of the application deadline specified in it, by sending the application to the specialized platform operator through the specialized electronic platform. The application period may not be less than five working days following the date on which the specialized platform operator sends the notification specified in paragraph 1(7)(а) of this Article.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 7. In a closed electronic tender, the application must contain the information and documents specified in Article 43(1) of this Federal Law, point 1, subpoints “м”–“р”, and points 2–5, and the information and documents required under Article 37(4) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 8. No later than one hour after the application deadline, the specialized electronic platform operator shall send the applications to the contracting authority under Article 43(6)(9) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 9. No later than five working days from the day following the application deadline, but no later than the date for determining supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results set in the procurement documentation:
units.label: Part 9 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 1) members of the procurement commission:
units.label: Point 1 Part 9 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: а) examine the applications received and decide, for each one, whether it complies with the procurement documentation or must be rejected;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 9 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: б) evaluate applications found to comply with the procurement documentation against the evaluation criteria established under Article 32 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 9 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: в) on the basis of the evaluation under subpoint “б” of this point, rank each application found to comply with the procurement documentation in descending order of the advantage of the contract performance terms offered, taking account of regulatory legal acts adopted under Article 14 of this Federal Law. The application of the winner of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection shall be ranked first. If several applications offer identical contract performance terms, the application received earlier than the others offering the same terms shall receive the lower rank number;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 9 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 2) the contracting authority shall use the specialized electronic platform to prepare the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results and, after the procurement commission members sign it with enhanced electronic signatures, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf and:
units.label: Point 2 Part 9 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: а) send every participant that submitted an application a notification containing the information specified in paragraph 11(2)–(4) of this Article concerning that participant’s application;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 9 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: б) post the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results in the unified information system without publishing it on the official website.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 9 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 10. A procurement application shall be rejected in the following cases:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 1) failure to provide the information and documents specified in paragraph 7 of this Article, except in cases provided for by this Federal Law, or in Article 43(6)(2) and (4) of this Federal Law, or failure of such information and documents to meet the requirements in the procurement documentation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 2) the participant does not meet the requirements set in the procurement documentation under Article 31(1) of this Federal Law, or the requirements set in it under Article 31(1.1), (2) and (2.1) of this Federal Law, where applicable;
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 3) the cases specified in Article 14 of this Federal Law: paragraph 4, point 1, subpoint “а” (except in the case provided for in point 4 of this paragraph), and point 2, subpoint “а”; and paragraph 5, point 1, subpoint “а” (except in the case provided for in point 4 of this paragraph), and point 2;
units.label: Point 3 Part 10 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 4) failure to provide the information and documents specified in Article 43(1)(5) of this Federal Law, if they are determined under Article 14(2)(2) of this Federal Law (where the procurement documentation prohibits procurement of goods originating in a foreign State under Article 14(2)(1)(а) of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 4 Part 10 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 5) the participant is found to be an organization specified in Article 2(4) of Federal Law No. 127-FZ of 4 June 2018 “On Measures to Influence (Counteract) Unfriendly Actions of the United States of America and Other Foreign States”, where the works or services being procured are included in the list determined by the Government of the Russian Federation under that point;
units.label: Point 5 Part 10 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 6) the cases provided for in Article 45(6) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 6 Part 10 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 7) inaccurate information is found in the procurement application.
units.label: Point 7 Part 10 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 11. The record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results must contain:
units.label: Part 11 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 1) the date on which supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results were determined; the information specified in Article 43(1)(1), subpoints “а” and “е”, of this Federal Law and entry numbers in the unified register of procurement participants for participants that submitted applications; and the identification numbers of those applications;
units.label: Point 1 Part 11 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 2) information on the decision that an application complies with the procurement documentation or is rejected, with reasons, specifying the provisions of this Federal Law and the procurement documentation with which it fails to comply, and the provisions of the application that do not comply with the procurement documentation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 11 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 3) the values awarded to applications found to comply with the procurement documentation under the evaluation criteria provided for in Article 32(1) of this Federal Law, where such criteria are established in the documentation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 11 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 4) the ranks assigned under paragraph 9(1)(в) of this Article;
units.label: Point 4 Part 11 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 5) information on conclusion of a contract at a price increased under Articles 28 and 29 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 11 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 6) information on the decision of each procurement commission member participating in examination of the applications concerning each application;
units.label: Point 6 Part 11 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 7) information that the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 77(1) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 7 Part 11 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 12. A participant that submitted an application may, after receiving the notification specified in paragraph 9(2)(а) of this Article but no later than the contract conclusion date, use the specialized electronic platform to ask its operator for clarification of the results of examination and evaluation of its application. The operator shall forward the request to the contracting authority no later than one hour after receiving it. No later than two working days following receipt of the request, the contracting authority shall send the relevant clarification to the specialized platform operator. No later than one hour after receiving it, the operator shall send it to the participant that requested clarification of the results of examination and evaluation of its application.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 13. A contract following a closed electronic tender shall be concluded in the procedure established by Article 51 of this Federal Law. Where Article 51 of this Federal Law provides for information and documents to be prepared and posted on an electronic platform, including through the unified information system, they shall instead be prepared and posted on the specialized electronic platform, including through the unified information system, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law. Such information and documents shall not be published on the official website.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Conduct of a closed electronic tender
units.text: 14. If a closed electronic tender is declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 77(1) of this Federal Law, it shall be conducted subject to the specific rules established by Article 77(2) and (4) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 75
